decisions.reason: The separate theorem thm-certified-bracketed-inverse-error, Statement and proof 1.1, proves exactly the bracket invariant, N+2 evaluation count and residual certificate: each branch preserves F(l)<=u<=F(r), the width is (b-a)2^-N, and monotonicity plus the supplied modulus bounds the residual. Its owning page lists both carriers. This algorithm specifies the procedure and its output certificate, not an unsupported phase proof; no missing correctness result exists.

Without integral endpoints c0=1/2,c1=1 is admitted and pi_k(c0) is undefined. Added integer endpoints. Inductively every active counter c0+j is in S, reaches c1 after c1-c0 outputs, and never wraps; the empty interval exhausts immediately. The direct consumer lem-counter-based-keyed-stream-no-reuse, Statement and steps 1.1/2.1, uses only these integer counters and injectivity, so remains sound. The owning page only places the algorithm.

The alleged missing period result is present: thm-lcg-full-period-and-adjacent-dependence proves the affine iterate, the exact 2-adic valuation of S_(2^k), return at 2^w and no shorter return, then permutation marginals and adjacent dependence. However the Definition omitted the explicit integer type of word width w, also flagged by Step 4. Made w an integer, a nonfatal domain clarification of the finite-residue convention; no period claim was weakened. Direct consumers are the period theorem and ex-lcg-low-bit-alternation (w=3); both use integral widths and stay sound.

F7 cited logarithm laws that do not state the inverse identities used to identify G; the direct prerequisite def-natural-logarithm supplies both exp(log u)=u and log(exp t)=t. Added that dependency, logarithm/inverse derivatives, circle parametrization/derivatives, the Euclidean local inverse theorem and exponential addition. Proof 1.1 now establishes the radial/angular bijection and forward determinant -2pi/u, so the local inverses combine into a C1 global inverse. Step 2.1 applies Borel change of variables on open D and removes only a Borel null ray. Tonelli normalizes the product density and proves independence; the exact radial event and tail integral give ER^2=2. Statement and choice assumptions are unchanged.

The owning page already contains the separate proved theorem thm-rational-bernoulli-rejection-law-and-cost. Its steps 1.1-3.1 prove per-attempt probability n/N, independent geometric failures, capped conditional Bernoulli(m/n) law, almost-sure termination and expected kN/n bits, with explicit zero-bit endpoint branches. The algorithm specifies fresh non-overlapping blocks, cap failure without a default value, and endpoint behavior exactly as that theorem requires. The allegation that no corresponding proved result exists is false; no algorithm edit is needed.

The cited generalized-inverse lemma has domain (0,1), so its attribution to every positive ideal input omitted endpoint justification. The algorithm itself is correct at 1: Cr=1 and the finite nonempty set of i with Ci=1 has a least element. Limited that citation to 0<U<1 and specified the same least-index endpoint extension at v=1, preserving every input and output. The separate theorem thm-finite-categorical-midpoint-count-bound, proof 3.1, already proves binary-search correctness for every 0<v<=1 including r=1; steps 1.1/1.2 prove the ideal and midpoint laws, allowing zero weights and threshold equality.

The cited countable-stream theorem states CC and DC, while A1 mentions only CC; however the only imported F1 claim is the elementary midpoint formula, and the example already gives two finite independent midpoint uniforms. Replaced that unnecessary theorem citation by the explicit finite-grid definition and minimum calculation, so no countable-stream realization or DC is required. CC remains exactly for the ideal Box-Muller radial-law supplier. Also cited def-natural-logarithm for exp(log(2^-9))=2^-9; log laws give log(2^-9)=-9log2. This proves the unchanged cutoff sqrt(18log2) and ideal tail 1/512 without strengthening the assumptions.

F2 and verification 2.1 incorrectly attributed necessity to a theorem that gives a sufficient positive-density condition. Replaced F2 by its exact interior-target hypotheses and linear conclusion; the proof now concludes only that no epsilon-independent constant C bounds this example by C epsilon. The explicit ratio 1/sqrt(epsilon) is unbounded, while the nonlinear error remains sqrt(epsilon). Stated that the endpoint convention Q(0)=0 is used directly and does not apply the cited theorem at zero; f=2x has essential infimum zero on every nondegenerate [0,h]. Added linear to the title to match the proved claim. The Example is unchanged, and there is no Statement/Definition interface event.
